claims.text: The BERT-based model encodes query relevance, document context, and salient meanings into vector representations using BERT.
The model uses a self-attention mechanism to jointly model query-sentence and sentence-sentence relationships.
The final summary is generated by selecting the highest ranking sentences based on the scores predicted by the model.
The model is fine-tuned to leverage general language representations of BERT, improving its performance on summarization tasks.
